answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Verified jury service record with court service attestation. It demands service the court recorded across years of trials, and the quartz is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the basalt compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the reef is that the farm's unit economics never work.
